comparison.objective: Sort colored cubes while responding to a timed high-level alarm by closing an inlet; candidate selectively removes open cartons from a moving belt.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-380 combines ordinary bin sorting with timed valve sliding. It does not test moving-carton tracking, flap-clearance entry, sidewall grasping, or spill-free transport of loose contents.
comparison.success_condition: PR-380 rewards correctly binned cubes and valve closure after the alarm but before overflow, with early closure capped. Candidate requires open-carton rejection, retained contents, released tray placement and untouched closed-carton passage.
comparison.reason: The only shared abstraction is state-conditioned intervention while another process continues; the manipulated mechanisms and tested physical abilities are materially different.
